episode.brief: Prepare next week's RAG research sprint. Delegate fixed-packet literature synthesis, execution-capacity planning, and an independent validity/reproducibility audit to three parallel workers, then integrate their evidence into exactly one falsifiable experiment plan. Preserve the PI's scientific ownership when several defensible contributions remain.

source.adaptation: Retains the fixed five-paper packet and adds deterministic capacity and methodological-validity streams, so PI attention follows converged novelty, feasibility, and reproducibility evidence rather than an abstract topic request.
source.license: Research metadata plus original JarvisBench fixture

summary: Develop three literature-grounded RAG directions, test their operational feasibility and methodological validity in parallel, then turn one PI-owned scientific choice into a reproducible sprint.
title: RAG research sprint selection and release review
